extensionDescription.message: A browser extension toolbox for YouTube / YouTube Music (www.youtube.com, music.youtube.com).

popupSubtitle.message: A browser extension toolbox for YouTube / YouTube Music (www.youtube.com, music.youtube.com).

alwaysShowDesc.message: Like or dislike songs without hovering over a row.

pinFilterSearchDesc.message: While find is open, keep the search bar under the top navigation.

settingsError.message: Could not load or save settings. Reopen this panel.

authorDescription.message: Group by each channel’s first appearance, then order each group by upload date, oldest first. Later duplicate songs are removed.

dateDescription.message: Order all songs by upload date, oldest first. Songs with the same date retain their relative order. Later duplicate songs are removed.

likeDescription.message: Like unrated songs. Skip liked, disliked, and unknown rating states.

copyDescription.message: Create a private copy of the current playlist.

cacheDescription.message: Progress appears on the page. Each playlist has its own cache; incremental scans retrieve new songs.

openPlaylistPrompt.message: Open a YouTube / YouTube Music playlist page.

panelOpened.message: The action panel is open. Progress appears on the page.

exportOpened.message: The Save As dialog is open.

closingPanel.message: Stopping. The panel will close after the current request.

panelFinished.message: You can close this panel. Open it from the toolbox for another action.

musicOnlyLike.message: Bulk liking is available on YouTube Music only.

platformSupport.message: YouTube supports playlist copying and both sort modes. Rating features are available on YouTube Music only.

unknownRatingHint.message: Open a song to check its rating. Unavailable tracks can be skipped.
